title: Smart Soil Testing & Irrigation
summary: Portable soil sensing, nutrient/NPK measurement, calibration and connected irrigation intelligence.
details: A field-ready soil monitoring and irrigation concept using embedded sensing, calibration workflows and connected dashboards. Designed to turn soil measurements into practical irrigation and crop-management decisions.
stack: ESP32-S3 • ESP-IDF • RS485/Modbus • Soil sensing • Wi-Fi • MQTT

title: SirenGuard Modular Emergency System
summary: Plug-and-play connected siren architecture with replaceable electronics and serviceable modules.
details: A modular emergency alert system in which controller, LTE/connectivity, audio, Class-D amplifier, power management and BMS sections can be replaced independently. Designed for public-safety and industrial alerting deployments.
stack: CM5 / ESP32-S3 • LTE • Ethernet • Wi-Fi • BLE • I²S • Class-D • BMS

title: HomeGuard Smart Water System
summary: Connected water monitoring and control for tanks, pumps, leakage and household water management.
details: HomeGuard combines water-level, flow and leakage sensing with automatic pump/control logic and connected monitoring. The architecture is modular for easier installation, maintenance and future sensor expansion.
stack: ESP32 • Level sensing • Flow sensing • Pump control • Wi-Fi • IoT

title: QBESIQ FactoryOS
summary: AI-powered factory intelligence for machine condition, production signals and actionable events.
details: QBESIQ FactoryOS is designed to answer three practical factory questions: what is going wrong, why is it happening, and what should be done. It combines edge sensing, machine data, analytics and dashboards into one scalable platform.
stack: Edge gateway • Vibration • Temperature • Current • RS485/Modbus • Edge AI • Dashboard

title: MachineGuard AI
summary: Machine condition monitoring using vibration, temperature and current to detect abnormal behavior early.
details: A compact monitoring node for motors and rotating assets. Multi-sensor data can be processed at the edge to identify abnormal behavior and publish machine-health indicators to the factory platform.
stack: 3-axis vibration • RTD/temperature • Current sensing • ESP32/STM32 • Edge analytics

title: Broken Part Detection
summary: Camera-based inspection for cracks, missing pieces, deformation and visible component damage.
details: A production-line vision station that identifies broken or damaged parts before the next process. Inspection results can be counted, logged and linked to production traceability.
stack: Industrial camera • Edge AI • OpenCV/AI model • Lighting • PLC/GPIO

title: Vision Detection System
summary: General-purpose machine vision for presence, position, orientation and visual-quality inspection.
details: A flexible industrial vision station for automated inspection. It can validate part presence, position, orientation and visual quality and provide pass/fail signals or upstream inspection data.
stack: Camera • Edge compute • Vision AI • OpenCV • PLC/GPIO • Industrial Ethernet

title: Smart Rainwater Harvesting Guardian
summary: Intelligent rainwater harvesting monitoring, water-quality checks, recharge control and remote alerts.
details: The Smart RWH Guardian turns an existing rainwater harvesting system into a measurable connected water-management system. It can monitor rainfall, tank level, flow, turbidity, pH, EC/TDS, temperature, pressure and leakage, with automation for pumps, valves, first-flush and recharge decisions.
stack: ESP32-S3 • Rain gauge • Level • Flow • Water quality • Pressure • Leak sensing • Wi-Fi/4G/RS485
